userStories.title: Add multi-factor strategy selection combining pattern, chapter, and confidence
userStories.notes: COMPLETED: Added confidence_weight: 0.2 config option in config.yaml. Implemented get_multi_factor_strategy_ranking() method in QueryLearningDB that combines pattern success rate (60%), chapter type success rate (40%), and confidence factor. Low confidence favors conservative strategies (voiceover, topic, entity), high confidence favors aggressive strategies (similar_locked). Added 8 tests verifying all acceptance criteria.
